correctness.rationale: Independent marking leaves the unmarked arrival-epoch queue stationary under the two-tag conditioning. With u=1-p, a=1/(1+rho p), d=1/(1+rho), b=1-d, the first tag has an Erlang(q+1,mu) sojourn given Q=q. If the gap to the known susceptible second tag is T, the later-mark avoidance factor is exp(-lambda p (D-T)_+); integrating its exponential first-arrival law gives (exp(-lambda p D)-p exp(-lambda D))/(1-p). Summing with the geometric Q law and u^Q yields the first marginal. At the second tag, if Q1>0, the first tag is exactly the newest predecessor, so its corresponding mark factor is u^(Q1-1), rather than u^Q1; if Q1=0 the factor is one. Its geometric marginal, memorylessness, and Erlang transform give (1-rho)(a+rho a^2/(1-rho ua)), the same s as the first marginal. For joint escape, every pre-first customer contacts the first tag and every post-second arrival before the second departure contacts the second tag. There is no untagged intervening arrival, and any post-second contact of the first tag is included because FCFS orders their departures, even if their visits are disjoint. Thus j=a E[u^Q a^Q1]. Before the second arrival, the independent potential-completion clock gives P(G=g)=b d^g and Q1=max(Q+1-G,0); summing the truncated geometric law gives E[u^Q z^Q1]=(1-rho)(d+bz/(1-rho uz))/(1-rho ud). Substitution at a gives j=as. Then j-s^2>0 since a-s=2p rho^2/((1+p rho)(1-rho+2p rho)); dividing by s(1-s) gives the correlation. The variance, ordered cells, and fixed-p heavy-traffic limit follow without boundary conditioning on null events. The source applies only to adjacent arrivals in the full stream, zero exposure threshold and no onward transmission. claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Mark thinning and the arrival-epoch stationary marginal are existing ingredients, but neither specifies E[u^Q a^Q1]. The two-arrival embedded kernel supplies the extra dependence calculation rather than a new name for a one-tag formula.

evidence: Given the unmarked queue, both tags escape with probability (1-p)^K where K counts distinct untagged customers overlapping their union. In the original marked model the unconditional-along-the-stream one-susceptible marginal at zero threshold is (1-rho)/(1-rho+2p rho), not s.

value.rationale: The adjacent pair is the first nontrivial dependence observable beyond a one-tag marginal in this stationary FIFO model. The joint calculation quantifies the exact error of an independence assumption for pair-count variance and shows that the rare-escape clustering does not vanish in heavy traffic. These are well-defined properties of the mathematical zero-threshold marked queue, not claims for longer lags or more general transmission mechanisms.
